extra-4787f987515e.zh-Hans: 真人实拍 + 2D 动漫贴纸合成搞笑短视频 【风格】 真人实拍 + Flat 2D Sticker Composite 搞笑短视频。 第一人称做饭视角，写实厨房质感与扁平卡通贴纸风格形成强烈反差。 整体为 Live-Action + Flat 2D Cartoon Sticker 混搭效果。 画面是 真实厨房实拍，角色是 全程保持纯 2D 平面贴纸质感 的 Q 版卡通角色。 8K 超清，竖屏，手持轻微晃动，短视频节奏明快，笑点直接。 【时长】 10 秒 【画幅】 9:16 竖屏 一、场景设定 【场景】 真实居家厨房第一人称视角。 黑色铁锅放在灶台上，锅里正在翻炒牛肉和青菜，油光滋滋，蒸汽上冒。 背景包含： 白色瓷砖墙 墙面插座 靠墙排列的酱油瓶和油瓶 右侧不锈钢水槽 侧窗自然光照入 要求整体环境 真实生活化，厨房质感可信，不能变成卡通厨房。 相机为第一人称 POV，轻微手持晃动，但不要晃得太乱。 二、角色设定 【角色】Q 版动漫贴纸角色：水豚噜噜（Capybara Lulu） 设定要求： 圆润可爱的拟人卡通水豚 正面站在画面中央偏下位置 身高约为铁锅的一半 扁平 2D 贴纸质感 明显卡通描边 纸片感强 不能变成立体真实动物 不被真实环境光重新塑造成写实立体光影 外观统一锁定： 身体为淡黄色 穿橙色短裤 脖子系黄色小围裙 头顶顶着一个小橘子 四只小短爪圆润如豆 头部 and 脸部占比很大 整体像软萌纸片贴纸角色 角色气质： 平时佛系慵懒 但一搞事就特别熟练 表情贱兮兮，恶作剧感强 【真人部分】 真人的手为写实风格，从画面右侧入画。 要求皮肤细节真实，毛孔可见，与 2D 角色形成明确反差。 三、镜头设计 【镜头 1｜00:00–00:03】 倒盐捣乱（Salt Avalanche Opening） 【机位】 第一人称俯视 POV 【画面动作】 真人的手正用锅铲翻炒锅里的牛肉和青菜。 水豚噜噜坐在灶台旁的小木凳上，眯起豆豆眼，腮红加深，嘴角上扬露出贱兮兮的坏笑。 它两只小短爪高高举起一个比自己脑袋还大的玻璃调料罐，趁真人炒菜时，把整罐白盐哗哗倒进锅里。 盐要像真实瀑布一样倾泻而下，清楚落进锅中，并在菜上堆成一座夸张但可见的“小白盐山”。 【角色表情】 豆豆眼微眯 嘴角坏笑 恶作剧得意 【音效】 食物滋滋声 盐倒入锅中的密集沙沙声 【本镜头唯一主要动作】 水豚噜噜把整罐盐倒进锅里。 【镜头 2｜00:03–00:05】 夺瓶敲头（Spatula Bonk） 【机位】 继续保持第一人称近景 POV 【画面动作】 真人一只手迅速夺走它怀里的玻璃盐罐。 另一只手举起锅铲，用铲面朝下，轻轻敲在水豚噜噜头顶。 注意这一下是 卡通式轻敲，不是现实暴力感。 敲击后，它头顶立刻弹出一个明显的红色卡通肿包。 它整个圆滚滚的 2D 贴纸身体上下猛地一颤，两只小短爪立刻抱头，豆豆眼瞬间瞪圆。 【角色表情】 震惊 委屈 打懵一瞬间 【音效】 锅铲 “Duang” 一声 轻微金属敲击音 卡通弹簧音效 【本镜头唯一主要动作】 真人用锅铲轻敲它的头顶。 【镜头 3｜00:05–00:08】 敲哭张嘴・铲盐入嘴（Cry & Feed） 【机位】 第一人称近景 POV，聚焦角色面部与锅边 【画面动作】 水豚噜噜捂着头顶的红色肿包，豆豆眼瞬间变成旋转蚊香眼。 它张大嘴巴“嗷嗷”大哭，蓝色卡通泪水像喷泉一样从两侧夸张喷出。 头顶的小橘子也随着哭泣一颤一颤。 与此同时，真人的手立刻用锅铲从锅里那座盐山上铲起满满一铲“白盐咸菜混合物”，趁它张嘴大哭时，精准把这一铲送进它嘴里。 它的嘴瞬间被塞得鼓鼓囊囊，左右腮帮子像两个半球一样夸张鼓起。 【角色表情】 蚊香眼 大哭 嘴被塞满后的震惊呆滞 【音效】 夸张卡通爆哭声 铲盐沙沙声 塞进嘴里的“啵”一声 【本镜头唯一主要动作】 真人趁它张嘴大哭时把一铲盐菜塞进它嘴里。 【镜头 4｜00:08–00:10】 齁到倒地（Salt K.O. Ending） 【机位】 第一人称固定近景，结尾定格 【画面动作】 水豚噜噜两边腮帮子鼓得通红，被迫咽下嘴里的盐。 它的瞳孔骤然缩成两个小点，淡黄色身体瞬间刷白一个色调，整只角色僵直抖动半拍。 紧接着，它的豆豆眼变成两个 “X”，身体直挺挺地从小木凳上向后仰倒，四脚朝天摔平在灶台上。 一只小短爪在空中无力划一下后垂落。 它头顶红肿包旁边缓缓绕出一圈旋转小星星。 方形小鼻子前悠悠飘出一缕灵魂状白烟。 画面定格在它“齁到升天”的瞬间。 【音效】 僵直 “咯噔” 一声 向后倒地 “咚” 一声 轻微卡通升天音效收尾 【本镜头唯一主要动作】 水豚噜噜被咸到后仰倒地。 四、执行要求 【视觉要求】 厨房环境必须真实写实 水豚噜噜必须始终保持纯 2D 贴纸感 2D 角色与真实厨房、真实人手形成强烈反差 不要把水豚噜噜做成立体真实毛绒动物 不要让角色接受复杂写实打光 角色轮廓始终清楚，像贴在实拍画面上的卡通贴纸 【动作要求】 每个镜头只保留一个主要动作 动作节奏要短平快 角色表情夸张，但动作逻辑清楚 盐、锅铲、蒸汽、倒地要有明确物理反馈 【表演要求】 水豚噜噜的搞事感要强 真人不出全身，只出现手 真人的反应要利落，像熟练处理捣蛋鬼 整体是无台词喜剧，不需要人物说话 【镜头要求】 全片保持第一人称 POV 轻微手持晃动 不切换成第三人称 不增加无关人物 结尾定格要干脆 五、负面词 blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, subtitles, text, logo, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, extra limbs, broken hands, disfigured, bad composition, out of frame; realistic animal fur, 3D realistic capybara, over-rendered lighting on sticker character, inconsistent character, changing clothes, changing body color, changing head accessory; background shift, disappearing props, broken kitchen continuity, floating objects, incorrect POV, extra people, extra hands, glitching cuts
extra-4787f987515e.en: Live-action footage + 2D anime sticker composite funny short video [Style] Live-action footage + Flat 2D Sticker Composite funny short video. First-person cooking perspective, with a strong contrast between realistic kitchen texture and flat cartoon sticker style. The overall effect is Live-Action + Flat 2D Cartoon Sticker mixed style. The image is a real kitchen live-action shot, and the character is a chibi cartoon character that maintains a pure 2D flat sticker texture throughout. 8K ultra-clear, vertical screen, slight handheld shake, fast-paced short-video rhythm, direct punchlines. [Duration] 10 seconds [Aspect ratio] 9:16 vertical screen 1. Scene setting [Scene] First-person perspective of a real home kitchen. A black iron wok is placed on the stove, and beef and green vegetables are being stir-fried in the wok, glistening with oil, steam rising. The background includes: white tile wall, wall socket, soy sauce bottles and oil bottles lined up against the wall, stainless steel sink on the right, natural light coming in from the side window. The overall environment must be real and lifelike, with credible kitchen texture, and must not become a cartoon kitchen. The camera is first-person POV, with slight handheld shake, but not too chaotic. 2. Character setting [Character] Chibi anime sticker character: Capybara Lulu (Capybara Lulu) Setting requirements: round and cute anthropomorphic cartoon capybara, standing front-facing at the center-lower position of the frame, about half the height of the wok, flat 2D sticker texture, obvious cartoon outline, strong paper-cut feel, must not become a three-dimensional realistic animal, must not be re-shaped by real environmental light into realistic three-dimensional lighting, appearance uniformly locked: body is pale yellow, wearing orange shorts, a small yellow apron tied around the neck, a small orange on top of the head, four small short paws round like beans, head and face occupy a large proportion, overall like a soft cute paper sticker character. Character temperament: usually laid-back and lazy, but especially skilled once causing trouble, with a cheeky expression and a strong prankster feel. [Live-action part] The real person's hands are in realistic style, entering the frame from the right side. Skin details must be real, pores visible, forming a clear contrast with the 2D character. 3. Shot design [Shot 1 | 00:00–00:03] Salt Avalanche Opening [Camera position] First-person top-down POV [On-screen action] The real person's hand is stir-frying the beef and green vegetables in the wok with a spatula. Capybara Lulu sits on a small wooden stool beside the stove, squinting its bean eyes, blush deepening, corners of the mouth raised in a cheeky evil grin. It raises high with its two small short paws a glass seasoning jar bigger than its own head, and while the real person is cooking, pours the entire jar of white salt clattering into the wok. The salt must pour down like a real waterfall, clearly falling into the wok, and pile up on the vegetables into an exaggerated but visible "little white salt mountain." [Character expression] Bean eyes slightly squinted, evil grin at the corners of the mouth, smug about the prank [Sound effects] Food sizzling, dense rustling of salt pouring into the wok [The only main action of this shot] Capybara Lulu pours the entire jar of salt into the wok. [Shot 2 | 00:03–00:05] Spatula Bonk [Camera position] Continue maintaining first-person close-up POV [On-screen action] One of the real person's hands quickly snatches away the glass salt jar from its arms. The other hand raises the spatula and, with the spatula face downward, lightly taps the top of Capybara Lulu's head. Note that this is a cartoon-style light tap, not a realistic sense of violence. After the tap, an obvious red cartoon bump immediately pops out on top of its head. Its entire round 2D sticker body jolts up and down sharply, its two small short paws immediately clutch its head, and its bean eyes instantly widen round. [Character expression] Shocked, aggrieved, momentarily stunned [Sound effects] Spatula "Duang" sound, slight metallic tap sound, cartoon spring sound effect [The only main action of this shot] The real person lightly taps the top of its head with the spatula. [Shot 3 | 00:05–00:08] Cry & Feed [Camera position] First-person close-up POV, focusing on the character's face and the edge of the wok [On-screen action] Capybara Lulu clutches the red bump on top of its head, and its bean eyes instantly turn into spinning spiral eyes. It opens its mouth wide and cries "waa waa," with blue cartoon tears spraying out exaggeratedly from both sides like fountains. The little orange on top of its head also trembles with the crying. At the same time, the real person's hand immediately scoops up a full spatula of "white salt and salty vegetable mixture" from the salt mountain in the wok, and while it is crying with its mouth open, precisely delivers this spatula into its mouth. Its mouth is instantly stuffed bulging, and the cheeks on both sides bulge exaggeratedly like two hemispheres. [Character expression] Spiral eyes, crying loudly, stunned blankness after the mouth is stuffed full [Sound effects] Exaggerated cartoon bawling, rustling of scooping salt, a "pop" sound as it is stuffed into the mouth [The only main action of this shot] The real person, while it is crying with its mouth open, stuffs a spatula of salt and vegetables into its mouth. [Shot 4 | 00:08–00:10] Salt K.O. Ending [Camera position] First-person fixed close-up, freeze-frame at the end [On-screen action] Both cheeks of Capybara Lulu bulge bright red, forced to swallow the salt in its mouth. Its pupils suddenly shrink to two small dots, its pale yellow body instantly pales by one tone, and the whole character stiffens and trembles for half a beat. Immediately after, its bean eyes turn into two "X"s, and its body falls straight backward from the small wooden stool, landing flat on the stove with all four feet up. One small short paw weakly paddles in the air once and then drops. Beside the red swollen bump on top of its head, a ring of small spinning stars slowly circles out. In front of its small square nose, a wisp of soul-like white smoke drifts out leisurely. The image freezes on the moment it is "so salty it ascends to heaven." [Sound effects] Stiffening "clack" sound, falling backward "thud" sound, slight cartoon ascension sound effect to close [The only main action of this shot] Capybara Lulu falls backward after being overwhelmed by saltiness. 4. Execution requirements [Visual requirements] The kitchen environment must be real and realistic. Capybara Lulu must always maintain a pure 2D sticker feel. The 2D character forms a strong contrast with the real kitchen and real human hands. Do not make Capybara Lulu into a three-dimensional realistic plush animal. Do not let the character receive complex realistic lighting. The character outline must always be clear, like a cartoon sticker pasted onto the live-action footage. [Action requirements] Keep only one main action per shot. The action rhythm must be short, flat, and fast. Character expressions are exaggerated, but the action logic is clear. Salt, spatula, steam, and falling must have clear physical feedback. [Performance requirements] Capybara Lulu's troublemaking feel must be strong. The real person does not appear full-body, only hands appear. The real person's reactions must be crisp, like skillfully handling a troublemaker. The whole thing is a no-dialogue comedy, no character speech needed. [Camera requirements] Maintain first-person POV throughout. Slight handheld shake. Do not switch to third person. Do not add irrelevant people. The ending freeze-frame must be crisp. 5. new-224.zh-Hans: 诗意仙侠冷面反转喜剧 【风格】 诗意仙侠冷面反转喜剧，写实真人，真实电影高清质感。 采用古典中国画式构图、克制的武侠表演、清晨柔雾、低饱和玉绿色与象牙白色调、优雅稳定的运镜。 前半段营造“轻功高深、仙气十足”的庄重氛围，后半段通过视觉揭晓完成冷面反转，拆穿女主精心维持的仙人形象。 全片为纯古代中国世界，不出现任何现代物品、现代语言、现代建筑、现代音效或现代设计元素。 喜剧效果依靠清楚的空间关系、前置铺垫、镜头揭晓和人物冷静补刀完成，避免夸张搞怪表演。 【时长】 15 秒，三镜头结构，2 人出镜。 【画幅】 16:9 横屏，24fps。 一、场景设定 【场景】 清晨僻静的山门荷塘边。 墨绿色平静水面倒映着一棵老柳、缓慢漂浮的薄雾、白石平台、远处木质水榭、错落荷叶和风化石灯。 全片始终保持同一片荷塘、同一棵垂柳、同样的薄雾、同一块白石平台、同一座远处水榭和同一组荷叶分布。 空间关系必须稳定清楚，便于最后揭晓水下石桩的真实位置。 二、角色锁定 【角色 A｜剑仙师姐】 25–30 岁东亚女性。 椭圆脸，白皙自然肤色，深色杏眼，黑色长发半挽，以白玉簪固定，身材高挑纤细。 固定服装为：白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明分层宽袖、浅银色腰封、玉佩、白色布靴。 气质清冷、自信、克制，始终努力维持高人姿态。 【角色 B｜小师妹】 20–25 岁东亚女性。 圆润灵动的脸，黑发编辫，身形娇小。 固定服装为：青绿色亚麻汉服、深色布腰带、木簪、黑色布鞋。 气质真诚、自然、崇拜师姐，但最终补刀平静直接，形成冷面喜剧效果。 三、分镜设计 【镜头 1｜0–5s】 【机位】低角度全景横向跟拍 【主要动作】剑仙师姐在水面上轻盈前行 清晨僻静的山门荷塘边，墨绿色平静水面上漂着薄雾，岸边有白石平台，远处有木质水榭，荷叶错落，老柳轻垂。 同一个剑仙师姐从左向右行走在水面上，从鞋到头完整可见，双手负后，下巴微抬，每一步都显得轻若无物，姿态优雅稳定。 同一个小师妹站在白石岸边，发自内心地仰望她。 镜头低角度横向跟拍，运镜平稳克制，突出她仿佛“踏水无痕”的仙气。 【声音】 庄重古琴、轻微晨风、水面细小涟漪声、远处鸟鸣。 【镜头 new-224.en: Poetic xianxia deadpan twist comedy [Style] Poetic xianxia deadpan twist comedy, realistic live-action, real cinematic HD texture. Uses classical Chinese painting-style composition, restrained wuxia performance, soft morning mist, low-saturation jade-green and ivory-white tones, elegant stable camera movement. The first half builds a solemn atmosphere of "profound qinggong, full of immortal aura," and the second half completes the deadpan twist through a visual reveal, exposing the female lead's carefully maintained immortal image. The entire film is a pure ancient Chinese world, with no modern objects, modern language, modern architecture, modern sound effects, or modern design elements. The comedy relies on clear spatial relationships, setup, camera reveal, and the characters' calm finishing blows, avoiding exaggerated comedic performance. [Duration] 15 seconds, three-shot structure, 2 people on screen. [Aspect ratio] 16:9 landscape, 24fps. 1. Scene setting [Scene] Beside a secluded mountain-gate lotus pond in the early morning. The dark green calm water reflects an old willow, slowly drifting thin mist, a white stone platform, a distant wooden waterside pavilion, scattered lotus leaves, and a weathered stone lantern. Throughout the film, always keep the same lotus pond, the same weeping willow, the same thin mist, the same white stone platform, the same distant waterside pavilion, and the same arrangement of lotus leaves. Spatial relationships must be stable and clear, to facilitate the final reveal of the true position of the underwater stone stakes. 2. Character lock [Character A | Sword Immortal Senior Sister] 25–30 year old East Asian woman. Oval face, fair natural skin tone, dark almond eyes, long black hair half tied up, fixed with a white jade hairpin, tall and slender figure. Fixed costume: white embroidered silk hanfu, semi-transparent layered wide sleeves, light silver waist sash, jade pendant, white cloth boots. Temperament is cold, confident, restrained, always striving to maintain a superior posture. [Character B | Junior Sister] 20–25 year old East Asian woman. Round, lively face, black hair in a braid, petite figure. Fixed costume: teal linen hanfu, dark cloth belt, wooden hairpin, black cloth shoes. Temperament is sincere, natural, admiring of senior sister, but ultimately delivers the finishing blow calmly and directly, creating a deadpan comedy effect. 3. Storyboard design [Shot 1 | 0–5s] [Camera position] Low-angle full shot horizontal tracking [Main action] Sword Immortal Senior Sister walks lightly on the water surface. Beside the secluded mountain-gate lotus pond in the early morning, thin mist drifts on the dark green calm water, a white stone platform on the shore, a wooden waterside pavilion in the distance, scattered lotus leaves, an old willow drooping lightly. The same Sword Immortal Senior Sister walks on the water surface from left to right, fully visible from shoes to head, hands behind her back, chin slightly raised, each step seeming light as nothing, posture elegant and stable. The same Junior Sister stands on the white stone shore, looking up at her from the bottom of her heart. The camera tracks horizontally at a low angle, movement steady and restrained, highlighting her immortal aura as if "walking on water without a trace." [Sound] Solemn guqin, slight morning breeze, small ripples on the water, distant birdsong. [Shot 2 | 5–10s] [Camera position] Medium shot side tracking [Main action] Junior Sister asks a question, Senior Sister responds in all seriousness. The same Junior Sister follows along the shore, looks up and asks: "师姐，这就是踏水无痕？" (Senior Sister, is this walking on water without a trace?) The same Sword Immortal Senior Sister keeps a calm, profound smile and answers: "心若无尘，水自承身。" (If the heart is free of dust, the water bears the body of itself.) She continues stepping forward, the same pair of white cloth boots landing precisely on the seemingly empty water surface. The background always keeps the same lotus pond, the same weeping willow, the same thin mist, the white stone platform, and the distant waterside pavilion. The camera rhythm is unhurried, focusing on reinforcing the illusion that "she really seems able to walk on water." [Sound] Dialogue uses native Mandarin, accurate lip sync. Guqin continues, ambient sound keeps the quiet early-morning texture. [Shot 3 | 10–15s] [Camera position] Low water-surface close-up reveal, then hard cut to extreme close-up [Main action] Reveal the underwater stone stakes, complete the twist. The camera lowers to the lotus pond water surface height, clearly revealing a row of squarely arranged square stone stakes hidden below the water surface. The same Sword Immortal Senior Sister is actually stepping precisely on these stone stakes as she moves forward, not truly walking on water without a trace at all. The same Junior Sister on the shore lifts the last stone stake at her feet that has not yet been placed into the water, and says with a deadpan face: "师姐，剩下这些石桩，今晚还搬吗？" (Senior Sister, these remaining stone stakes, are we still moving them tonight?) The guqin sound suddenly stops on a broken note. Then a hard cut to an extreme close-up of the Sword Immortal Senior Sister. Her eyebrow twitches slightly, the superior smile she was striving to maintain instantly freezes, and a drop of fine sweat appears by her temple. A lone frog croak comes from the distance. The image holds on the moment when she pretends to be calm but is clearly exposed, and ends. 4. Performance requirements [Sword Immortal Senior Sister] For the first 10 seconds she must always maintain a cold, profound, restrained, confident immortal posture. After the twist, do not exaggerate with jumping or shouting; the humor comes from micro-expression failure. Focus on: slight eyebrow twitch, frozen smile, fine sweat appearing, brief freeze after dignity is damaged. [Junior Sister] First half sincere admiration. The final finishing line should be calm and natural, like seriously asking a practical question. The calmer the tone, the stronger the comedic effect. 5. Technical execution requirements [Continuity requirements] The three shots must be continuous occurrences in the same scene. Character faces, hairstyles, costumes, and body proportions stable throughout. Senior Sister always moves from left to right. Junior Sister always follows on the shore. The underwater stone stake positions must strictly correspond to the positions where Senior Sister stepped earlier. No additional characters. No shot jumps, character teleportation, background drift, or prop disappearance. [Physical effects requirements] Physical effects of water surface, thin mist, reflections, lotus leaves, hair, and silk fabric are realistic. When the water surface supports footsteps there must be subtle natural feedback. When revealing the stone stakes, the water's transparency, refraction, and stone stake positions must be clear and believable. Details of fine sweat, hair strands, and fabric must match close-up cinematic texture. [Sound requirements] Native Mandarin dialogue. Accurate lip sync. No subtitles generated. No modern notification sounds or modern music. Sound effects retain only guqin, morning breeze, water sounds, birdsong, distant frog croaks, and other ancient-style ambient sounds. [Editing requirements] Camera movement elegant and stable. Clean shot transitions. Shot 3 uses a clear hard cut from reveal to close-up. Ending pause is clean, preserving the lingering deadpan twist. 6.
